init_sam_perception: initialize a SAMPerception instance with a custom vocabulary and MobileSAM checkpoint file
reset_vocab_sam_perception: reset the custom vocabulary of a SAMPerception instance to new detection classes
generate_masks_sam_perception: generate automatic segmentation masks for an image using the SAM mask generator
segment_with_boxes_sam_perception: segment an image by prompting SAM with bounding boxes to produce per-box masks
review_sam_perception_class: review the SAMPerception class and its MobileSAM predictor and mask generator setup
